# Recorded trace fixtures (IP-005)

These fixtures were derived by matchers from real sandbox traces, not hand-labelled.
Every fixture is `source: recorded` with `provenance.derived: true`. They hold only
public content from https://github.com/abliter8-ai/filmcraft at commit `7b6c13447228` and our inert, clearly-fake traps.

- gate fixtures: 43
- post_result fixtures: 16

The fork is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; its licence texts, NOTICE and
attribution are committed beside these fixtures. Run them through the existing
measurement script with `--fixtures <this dir> --scopes none`.
